scope: Different-author, read-only audit of the consumed M1877 C2 fresh-mapped Formality/dual-corner-PT attempt, its sealed attempt latch and failure quarantine, K8 Formality and K8 PT artifacts, and the absent K1X8 axis. No EDA, license query, retry, source mutation, predecessor mutation, or docs/359 mutation was performed.
verdict: M1877 is correctly FAIL_CLOSED. K8 raw Formality is a genuine diagnostic success with a valid ARCH_MODE=0 pair, 33,656 passing compare points, zero failing/aborted/unverified/unmatched points, BBPin=0, no actionable nonzero DESIGN LIBRARY unresolved/empty/unlinked instances, and only the exact symmetric TECH SNPS_BUSHOLD case. K8 PT produced a complete diagnostic report set but logged PT-063 and, independently, measured setup WNS +0.001767 ns with zero setup violations and hold WNS -0.023259 ns with 30,442 hold violations. K1X8 did not run because the runner fail-closed immediately after K8 PT reported Error/Fatal. No quarantined half-axis result is production-admitted or paper-citable.

execution_audit.sequence_stop_reason: run_tool rejects any line beginning Error: or Fatal: before verify_pt and before the K1X8 loop iteration

k8_pt.error_identity: PT-063 Library Compiler executable path is not set

findings.finding: K8 PT logged PT-063 because the Library Compiler executable path was not configured. Although PT continued and generated complete reports, the frozen runner correctly rejects any Error/Fatal and quarantined the entire attempt before K1X8.
findings.impact: The consumed M1877 namespace cannot admit any Formality/PT result, and K1X8 has no execution evidence.
findings.minimal_fix: In a new additive campaign, configure the valid Library Compiler path/tool environment and preserve the fail-closed Error/Fatal parser. Do not whitelist or ignore PT-063. This fix alone is insufficient because K8 has real hold violations and K1X8 is absent.

findings.finding: The complete K8 PT reports show hold WNS -0.023259 ns and 30,442 hold-violating paths under fast-min OCV, despite setup WNS +0.001767 ns and zero setup violations.
findings.impact: K8 is not timing closed. Re-running the same mapped netlist after only an environment fix would reproduce a hold-failing half-axis and cannot close C2.
findings.minimal_fix: Generate new hold-repaired K8 and matched K1X8 DC netlists under the same clock/uncertainty, for example with set_fix_hold plus incremental compile while protecting setup. Re-export SDC/SVF, then rerun Formality and dual-corner PT for both axes. Require nonnegative setup/hold WNS and zero violating paths for both axes; report area/setup/power impact of repair.

findings.finding: Analysis coverage has zero untested register setup/hold checks, but 140 out_setup and 140 out_hold checks are untested with reason no_paths; All Checks therefore contains 280 untested checks even though its printed percentage rounds to 0%.
findings.impact: A future paper cannot claim globally zero untested checks from the rounded coverage table.
findings.minimal_fix: Resolve dead/constant output semantics by correct constraints, removal of truly dead ports, or a per-bit structural proof and explicit waiver. Preserve the raw counts and never infer zero from the rounded percentage.
